name: Mirror Golem — protection from each card type of the exiled card
notes: Memory: project_imprint_implementation_2026-05-25. Myr Welder is an artifact creature card, so Mirror Golem gets protection from artifacts and from creatures; subtypes (Myr) give none. A non-tagged card in exile (Lightning Bolt) must not add protection from instants. NOTE: exile ids are literal; build in its own process.
